modelDescriptions.google-nano-banana-2: Google's everyday Gemini image model (Nano Banana 2.1). Generates and edits from text and reference images at 1K, 2K or 4K.
modelDescriptions.vertex-nano-banana-2: Google's everyday Gemini image model (Nano Banana 2.1). Generates and edits from text and reference images at 1K, 2K or 4K.
modelDescriptions.google-nano-banana-pro: Google's Gemini 3 Pro image model, built for complex scenes and text inside images. Up to 4K; slower and costlier than nano banana 2.1.
modelDescriptions.vertex-nano-banana-pro: Google's Gemini 3 Pro image model, built for complex scenes and text inside images. Up to 4K; slower and costlier than nano banana 2.1.
modelDescriptions.google-nano-banana-2-lite: Google's lightest Gemini image model: fast and low-cost, 1K output only.
modelDescriptions.vertex-nano-banana-2-lite: Google's lightest Gemini image model: fast and low-cost, 1K output only.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.8-flash-text: Google's newest Gemini Flash model: fast, with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.8-flash-text: Google's newest Gemini Flash model: fast, with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.7-flash-text: A fast Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.7-flash-text: A fast Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.6-flash-text: An earlier Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.6-flash-text: An earlier Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It runs on Google's tuned sampling, so the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.5-flash-text: An earlier Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It takes the temperature setting.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.5-flash-text: An earlier Gemini Flash model with a 1M-token context. It takes the temperature setting.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.5-flash-lite-text: The cheapest, fastest Gemini 3.5 tier, for simple high-volume text jobs. 1M-token context; the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.5-flash-lite-text: The cheapest, fastest Gemini 3.5 tier, for simple high-volume text jobs. 1M-token context; the temperature setting is not sent.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.1-pro-text: Google's Pro-tier reasoning model (preview), for harder writing and analysis. Slower and costlier than Flash; 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.1-pro-text: Google's Pro-tier reasoning model (preview), for harder writing and analysis. Slower and costlier than Flash; 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.1-flash-lite-text: A low-cost Gemini 3.1 tier for simple, high-volume text jobs. 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.1-flash-lite-text: A low-cost Gemini 3.1 tier for simple, high-volume text jobs. 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.google-lyria-3-clip-audio: Google's Lyria 3 music model for short pieces: always a 30-second clip, instrumental or with lyrics. A reference image can set the mood.
modelDescriptions.vertex-lyria-3-clip-audio: Google's Lyria 3 music model for short pieces: always a 30-second clip, instrumental or with lyrics. A reference image can set the mood.
modelDescriptions.google-lyria-3-pro-audio: Google's Lyria 3 Pro music model for full songs of a couple of minutes, with the length steered by the prompt. A reference image can set the mood.
modelDescriptions.vertex-lyria-3-pro-audio: Google's Lyria 3 Pro music model for full songs of a couple of minutes, with the length steered by the prompt. A reference image can set the mood.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-3.1-flash-tts-audio: Gemini 3.1 Flash text-to-speech (preview). 30 voices, for one speaker or a two-speaker dialogue.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-3.1-flash-tts-audio: Gemini 3.1 Flash text-to-speech (preview). 30 voices, for one speaker or a two-speaker dialogue.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-2.5-flash-tts-audio: Gemini 2.5 Flash text-to-speech: fast and low-cost. 30 voices, one or two speakers.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-2.5-flash-tts-audio: Gemini 2.5 Flash text-to-speech: fast and low-cost. 30 voices, one or two speakers.
modelDescriptions.google-gemini-2.5-pro-tts-audio: Gemini 2.5 Pro text-to-speech, for more expressive narration. 30 voices, one or two speakers.
modelDescriptions.vertex-gemini-2.5-pro-tts-audio: Gemini 2.5 Pro text-to-speech, for more expressive narration. 30 voices, one or two speakers.
modelDescriptions.google-gemma-4-31b-it-text: Google's open-weights Gemma 4 (31B, instruction-tuned), served through the Gemini API. 128K-token context.
modelDescriptions.google-veo-3.1-video: Google's Veo 3.1 video model, with generated sound. 4–8 second clips at 720p, 1080p or 4K, in 16:9 or 9:16.
modelDescriptions.google-veo-3.1-lite-video: A cheaper, faster Veo 3.1 tier. 4–8 second clips at 720p or 1080p, in 16:9 or 9:16.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-nano-banana-2: Google's nano banana 2 through RunningHub. Up to 4K; with the auto ratio the model picks the framing.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-nano-banana-pro: Google's nano banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro image) through RunningHub. Up to 4K, with up to 10 reference images for edits.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-gpt-image-2-5-sunburst: OpenAI's quality-tuned GPT Image 2.5 tier on RunningHub's economy channel. Up to 4K; 20,000-character prompts.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-gpt-image-2-5-flare: OpenAI's speed-tuned GPT Image 2.5 tier on RunningHub's economy channel, with quality close to GPT Image 2. Up to 4K.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-gpt-image-2-5-official-token-: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst on RunningHub's official-token channel. Adds quality tiers up to Max, transparent backgrounds and 32,000-character prompts.
GPT Image 2.5 Flare on RunningHub's official-token channel. Adds quality tiers up to Max, transparent backgrounds and 32,000-character prompts.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-gpt-image-2: OpenAI's GPT Image 2 on RunningHub's economy channel. Up to 4K.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-gpt-image-2-official: GPT Image 2 on RunningHub's official channel, which adds a Low, Medium or High quality tier to each resolution.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-qwen-image-2-pro: Alibaba's Qwen Image 3 Pro through RunningHub, the higher-quality Qwen tier. Edits with 1–3 reference images; no 21:9.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-qwen-image-3: Alibaba's standard Qwen Image 3 through RunningHub. Edits with 1–3 reference images; no 21:9.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-grok-imagine-pro: xAI's Grok Imagine quality tier through RunningHub. Edits take one reference image; prompts are capped at 4,000 characters.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-seedream-5-0-pro: ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Pro, RunningHub's Dola listing. Generates, or edits with up to 10 reference images, at 1K or 2K.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-seedream-5-0-pro-layer-decomp: Splits one image into a base image plus up to 16 transparent PNG layers, each saved to the album. Needs one source image; the optional prompt names what to separate.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-seedream-v5-pro: ByteDance's Seedream V5 Pro on RunningHub. Generates, or edits with up to 10 reference images, at 1K or 2K; prompts are capped at 2,000 characters.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-wan-2-7-pro: Alibaba's Wan 2.7 Pro image model through RunningHub. Prompts over 2,048 characters are cut to fit.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-seedance-2-0-global-video: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 (global) through RunningHub. 4–15 second clips from text or a first-frame image, up to 4K, with optional sound.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-seedance-2-0-global-multimoda: Seedance 2.0 (global) guided by reference images, video and audio together, through RunningHub. 4–15 seconds, up to 4K, with optional sound.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-minimax-hailuo-h3-video: MiniMax Hailuo H3 image-to-video through RunningHub. Animates a first-frame image into a 5–15 second clip at 768P or 2K; needs an image.
modelDescriptions.runninghub-minimax-hailuo-h3-multimodal-: Hailuo H3 guided by reference images, video and audio, through RunningHub. 5–15 second clips at 768P or 2K.
modelDescriptions.kling-omni-image-o1: Kling's O1 image model, which generates and edits from several reference images. 1K or 2K.
modelDescriptions.kling-v3-omni-image: Kling's V3 Omni image model: generation and editing from several reference images, up to 4K.
modelDescriptions.kling-v3-image: Kling's V3 standard image model, at 1K or 2K; it uses one reference image.
modelDescriptions.kling-v2-1-image: Kling's V2.1 standard image model, at 1K or 2K; it uses one reference image.
modelDescriptions.kling-v2-image: Kling's V2 standard image model, at 1K or 2K; it uses one reference image.
modelDescriptions.kling-v1-5-image: Kling's V1.5 standard image model, at 1K or 2K; it uses one reference image.
modelDescriptions.kling-v1-image: Kling's first image model, 1K only; it uses one reference image.
modelDescriptions.kling-video-o1-video: Kling's O1 video model. 3–10 second clips at 720p, with optional sound.
modelDescriptions.kling-v3-omni-video: Kling's V3 Omni video model. 3–10 second clips at 720p, with optional sound.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-image-2-5-sunburst: OpenAI's quality-tuned GPT Image 2.5 tier. Quality up to Max, and transparent backgrounds with PNG or WebP.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-image-2-5-flare: OpenAI's speed-tuned GPT Image 2.5 tier: quality close to GPT Image 2 at a lower cost. Transparent backgrounds with PNG or WebP.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-image-2: OpenAI's GPT Image 2. Quality up to High; no transparent background.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-image-1-mini: OpenAI's low-cost GPT Image 1 Mini. OpenAI retires it on December 1, 2026.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-5.6-text: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 flagship (the Sol tier), for the hardest reasoning and long tasks. 1M-token context; the most expensive GPT-5.6 tier.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-5.6-terra-text: The GPT-5.6 mid tier, for everyday production work. Cheaper than GPT-5.6; 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-5.6-luna-text: The fastest, cheapest GPT-5.6 tier, for high-volume jobs like summaries and drafts. 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-5.4-mini-text: A smaller, cheaper GPT-5.4 for everyday jobs. 400K-token context.
modelDescriptions.openai-gpt-5.4-nano-text: The smallest, cheapest GPT-5.4, for short high-volume jobs. 400K-token context.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-image-2.0: xAI's current Grok Imagine image model. Pick Low, Medium or High quality at 1K or 2K.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-image: xAI's earlier Grok Imagine 1.x standard tier, kept for projects that use it.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-image-pro: xAI's Grok Imagine 1.x quality tier, which replaced Imagine Pro in May 2026.
modelDescriptions.grok-4.6-text: xAI's newest Grok text model. 500K-token context.
modelDescriptions.grok-4.20-text: Grok 4.20 without reasoning, for quick answers. 2M-token context.
modelDescriptions.grok-4.1-fast-text: Fast, low-cost Grok 4.1 without reasoning. 2M-token context.
modelDescriptions.grok-imagine-video: xAI's Grok Imagine Video 1.5. 4–15 second clips at 720p or 1080p.
modelDescriptions.claude-fable-5-1-text: Anthropic's newest and most capable Claude, with always-on adaptive thinking. 1M-token context; temperature stays at the default.
modelDescriptions.claude-fable-5-text: Claude Fable 5, with always-on adaptive thinking. 1M-token context; temperature stays at the default.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-5-text: Claude Opus 5, for demanding writing and reasoning. 1M-token context; temperature stays at the default.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-8-text: Claude Opus 4.8. 1M-token context; temperature stays at the default.
modelDescriptions.claude-sonnet-5-text: Claude Sonnet 5, balancing speed, cost and capability. 1M-token context; temperature stays at the default.
modelDescriptions.claude-opus-4-6-text: Claude Opus 4.7, a previous-generation Opus. 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.claude-sonnet-4-6-text: Claude Sonnet 4.6, a previous-generation Sonnet. 1M-token context, up to 64K output.
modelDescriptions.claude-haiku-4-5-text: Anthropic's fast, low-cost Claude Haiku 4.5, for simple high-volume jobs. 200K-token context.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedream-5-0-pro: ByteDance's Seedream 5.0 Pro through your own BytePlus ModelArk key. 1K, 1.5K or 2K (1.5K is billed at the 1K rate), up to 10 reference images.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedream-5-0-lite: The lighter Seedream 5.0 tier through BytePlus, with 2K, 3K and 4K output.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedream-3-0-t2i: Seedream 3.0 text-to-image through BytePlus. It ignores reference images; 1K output.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seededit-3-0-i2i: ByteDance's instruction-based editor: changes one reference image the way the prompt describes. Needs an image.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedance-2-5-video: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 through BytePlus, guided by text plus reference images, video and audio, with optional sound. 480p or 720p.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedance-1-5-pro-video: Seedance 1.5 Pro through BytePlus. 4–12 second clips up to 1080p.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedance-1-0-pro-video: Seedance 1.0 Pro through BytePlus. 2–12 second clips up to 1080p.
modelDescriptions.byteplus-seedance-1-0-pro-fast-video: A faster, cheaper Seedance 1.0 Pro through BytePlus. 2–12 second clips up to 1080p.
modelDescriptions.replicate-seedance-2-0-fast-video: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 fast tier on Replicate: quicker, cheaper 5–8 second clips at 480p or 720p, with reference video and audio and optional sound.
modelDescriptions.replicate-seedance-2-0-video: ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 on Replicate, at 480p or 720p, with reference video and audio and optional sound.
modelDescriptions.replicate-flux-2-pro-image: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 [pro] on Replicate. Size is set in megapixels, up to 4 MP.
modelDescriptions.replicate-flux-2-flex-image: FLUX.2 [flex] on Replicate, with step and guidance controls for fine-tuning. Up to 4 MP.
modelDescriptions.replicate-flux-2-max-image: FLUX.2 [max], Black Forest Labs' highest-quality tier, on Replicate. Up to 4 MP.
modelDescriptions.alibabacloud-qwen3.6-max-text: Alibaba's Qwen3.6 flagship, for harder tasks. 256K-token context.
modelDescriptions.alibabacloud-qwen3.6-flash-text: The fast, low-cost Qwen3.6 tier. 128K-token context.
modelDescriptions.alibabacloud-qwen3.6-vl-max-text: Qwen3.6's vision-language flagship: reads the workflow's images along with the text.
modelDescriptions.alibabacloud-qwen3.6-vl-plus-text: A lighter Qwen3.6 vision-language model that reads the workflow's images along with the text.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m3-text: MiniMax's newest model. It reasons before answering, and the reasoning is kept out of the result. 1M-token context.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.7-text: MiniMax M2.7. It reasons before answering; 200K-token context.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.7-highspeed-text: MiniMax M2.7 served faster (about 100 tokens a second); same model.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.5-text: MiniMax M2.5. It reasons before answering; 200K-token context.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.5-highspeed-text: MiniMax M2.5 served faster; same model.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.1-text: MiniMax M2.1. It reasons before answering; 200K-token context.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2.1-highspeed-text: MiniMax M2.1 served faster; same model.
modelDescriptions.minimax-m2-text: MiniMax M2, the first M2 release. 200K-token context.
modelDescriptions.minimax-image-01: MiniMax Image 01, at 1K or 2K. Its reference input is one front-facing portrait used as a character reference, not general editing.
modelDescriptions.minimax-hailuo-h3-video: MiniMax Hailuo H3. 4–15 second clips at 768P or 2K; one or two images become the first and last frame, and reference video or audio switches it to reference mode.
modelDescriptions.minimax-music-3.0-audio: MiniMax Music 3.0. Mark lyrics with tags like [Verse] and [Chorus], or leave them out and it writes the lyrics; instrumental mode is also available.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-max: Black Forest Labs' highest-quality FLUX.2 tier. Size is set in megapixels, up to 4 MP.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-pro-preview: The latest FLUX.2 [pro], which Black Forest Labs updates over time.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-pro: A fixed snapshot of FLUX.2 [pro], for results that stay reproducible.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-flex: FLUX.2 [flex], with step and guidance controls for fine-tuning.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-klein-9b-preview: The latest FLUX.2 [klein] 9B, a small, fast model that Black Forest Labs updates over time.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-klein-9b: A fixed snapshot of FLUX.2 [klein] 9B, small and fast, for reproducible results.
modelDescriptions.bfl-flux-2-klein-4b: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, the smallest and fastest FLUX.2 model.
